scope: historical re-audit and all future no-odds candidates from v263 onward
honesty_note: D6-D9 and the 2026-07-02 to 2026-07-09 external block have been repeatedly observed. Historical v3 results rank development candidates only and are not untouched proof.

absolute_reference.role: stable common reference only; improvement versus v251 is not sufficient for promotion

development_champion.selection_status: retrospectively selected internal component; not eligible as untouched final proof

primary_test.metric: pooled exact-top3 race logloss delta versus development champion

multiplicity.family: all complete historical and future candidate probability files compared in the same audit
multiplicity.test: one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test over paired daily mean logloss deltas versus the development champion

statuses.promoted_development_challenger: mean below zero, CI95 upper below zero, and Holm-adjusted p below 0.05 versus champion
statuses.point_better_unconfirmed: mean below zero but uncertainty or multiplicity gate fails
statuses.worse_than_champion: mean above zero and CI95 lower above zero

external_policy.final_proof_requires: a separately frozen future block with no model, feature, threshold, or candidate selection after outcomes are opened
